Three contracts mention arbitration: Acme_MSA.pdf (§14.2), Brightline_SOW.docx (§9), and Northwind_NDA.pdf (§11). The other eight readable files have no mention.

Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf couldn't be checked. It's a scanned image with no extractable text, so it needs OCR or a manual read before you can rule it out.
